record.question: Which state has the maximum Ramsar wetland sites in India?
record.explanation: Answer C: Tamil Nadu. Tamil Nadu has the highest number of Ramsar sites in India in the source period; count is date-sensitive. Reference: https://moef.gov.in/ramsar-sites/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
